context: Second real measurement by the user (84-analyte report): split total AI 144s vs monolithic 120s, cost $0.142 vs ~$0.06. Breakdown from the Admin panel: A extraction 55.5s / ~13.5k tokens (~245 tok/s), B 7.7k tokens over 7 parallel batches (~15s), C on gemini-2.5-pro 3221 tokens of which 2898 thinking in ~85s (~38 tok/s). Diagnosis: the bottleneck is the VOLUME of serially generated output tokens, not thinking; 2.5-pro generates 6x slower than 2.5-flash; and the extraction was still one monolithic call.
fixes: Fix 1 — stage C moved from gemini-2.5-pro to gemini-2.5-flash with thinkingLevel=high (budget 16384, MORE reasoning than before, on a 6x faster engine). Expected: 85s -> ~18s.

Fix 2 — stage A split into 2 PARALLEL calls in TEXT mode (Gemini:ExtractorChunks). The report text is cut on line boundaries; every piece keeps the report header (patient data + column titles) and the pieces overlap by 4 lines so a row on the cut is readable in full somewhere. Tables are stitched back with dedupe on normalized name + value, patient_info is merged from whichever piece carried it. Any failure => automatic retry as ONE normal full-text extraction; the completeness sweep is the second net. Expected: 55s -> ~28s.

Fix 3 — dedicated SHORT system prompt for stage B: the explanation-depth policy and the multi-threshold rule are SLICED VERBATIM out of the full prompt (never rewritten, so they cannot drift), everything else is dropped. Measured: 5.856 chars vs 45.300 chars = 87% smaller, paid 7 times per report. Stage C keeps the FULL prompt (single call, quality first).
Fix 4 — stage A no longer emits _extraction_audit.parameter_names (a duplicate list of all 84 names); the sweep does that job now.

Admin — monolithic rows are now priced from their own tokens and model, so a new 'Cost AI' column compares money next to time; the A/B/C table shows how many parallel pieces the extraction used and the sweep cost is included in the AI total.
expected_effect: AI stage ~144s -> ~45-55s and cost ~$0.142 -> ~$0.07-0.08 (below today's monolithic). NOT yet measured against the real Google API — the user must re-run the same report.
test_type: END-TO-END probe against a local fake Gemini (HttpListener) driving the real service + unit checks on the completer (/app/memory/probes/GeminiSplitPipelineProbe.cs.txt)
